correctness.rationale: Each size≤2 equivalence relation is a unique involution, so E(X) requires truth at current world and two (possibly fixed) involution neighbors. Induction shows E^k(X) holds exactly when every world within graph radius k is in X. Thus maximum component diameter D suffices, and X excluding a world at distance D witnesses failure at D−1. The union of two colored matchings has connected components isolated vertices, alternately colored paths, even cycles, and a doubled 2-vertex edge; connected labelled counts are j! for a j-vertex path (including isolated j=1) and (2j−1)! for a 2j-vertex cyclic component (including doubled edge j=1). Exponential formula gives exp(sum z^j (j≤d+1)+sum z^(2j)/(2j) (j≤d)), with coefficientwise unrestricted exp(z/(1−z))/sqrt(1−z²)=Σ I_n² z^n/n!. A spanning alternating path has diameter n−1 and exactly n! ordered labelled realizations for n≥3; n=1,2 checked explicitly. Independent exact rational-generating-series and involution-pair enumeration through n=7 matched all depth counts, including n7 [1,3843,15540,14280,10080,5040,5040].
residual_risks: Labelled worlds and ordered distinguished relations; size≤2 cells and arbitrary events crucial.
Finite n census corroborates exact species/exponential-formula proof, not otherwise.

value.rationale: A complete labelled enumerative distribution of the uniform number of common-knowledge iterations is a natural exact invariant of a clearly motivated restricted information model, measuring the number of mutual-knowledge rounds to convergence. The diameter reduction plus component EGF yields an infinite n- and d-family, sharp worst-case count n!, and exact finite-size frequencies. It is not merely calculating a tiny frame or renaming a known scalar I_n² count: the depth truncation is a genuinely finer classification.
residual_risks: Exact species formulation could overlap a pre-existing combinatorial generating-function treatment not indexed as epistemic logic.

final_claim: For labelled n-world, ordered two-agent S5 frames with all information cells of size≤2, the least d for E^d(X)=C(X) for every event equals maximum component diameter of the two-involution union graph. The EGF of depth≤d counts is exp(Σ_{j=1}^{d+1}z^j+Σ_{j=1}^d z^{2j}/(2j)), and for n≥3 exactly n! frames have maximal depth n−1.
limitations: Only two distinguished agents, S5 equivalence blocks 1 or 2, ordered relations, labelled worlds; not arbitrary intuitionistic accessibility, number of agents or block size.
Residual risk of prior equivalent pair-of-involutions species enumeration.
